Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page

Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page
Test Data: First Name=spaces; Last Name=spaces; Postal Code=spaces
Steps: Enter whitespace-only values in all fields and click Continue

Test Case Title: Submit form with numeric and special-character names
Preconditions: User is on the checkout information page
Test Data: First Name=123!; Last Name=@Test; Postal Code=500075
Steps: Enter the supplied values and click Continue
Expected Result: The application applies its input validation policy consistently and either rejects invalid names with a clear message or proceeds according to the documented rules

Test Case Title: Submit form with long field values

Steps: Enter values longer than normal limits and click Continue
Expected Result: The application enforces field length limits without layout breakage or unexpected navigation
